provenance_policy: Strict provenance requirement: every identifier must be sourced from an official standards body (e.g., Bluetooth SIG), an operating system vendor (e.g., AOSP, Google), or a published hardware vendor technical specification. No unsourced or speculative entries are permitted.

entries.name: Generic Access Service
entries.analyst_notes: Standard mandatory GATT service (16-bit 0x1800) defining device name, appearance, and peripheral privacy flags.

entries.name: Generic Attribute Service
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT service (16-bit 0x1801) containing the Service Changed characteristic.

entries.name: Device Information Service
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT service (16-bit 0x180A) exposing manufacturer name, model number, serial number, and firmware revisions.

entries.name: Heart Rate Service
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT Heart Rate Service (16-bit 0x180D) widely used by health, fitness wearables, and chest straps.

entries.name: Battery Service
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT Battery Service (16-bit 0x180F) exposing Battery Level characteristic (0x2A19).

entries.name: Current Time Service
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT Current Time Service (16-bit 0x1805) for time synchronization between devices.

entries.name: Human Interface Device Service
entries.analyst_notes: Standard HID over GATT Profile (HOGP) service (16-bit 0x1812) for keyboards, mice, and gamepads.

entries.name: Location and Navigation Service
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT Location and Navigation Service (16-bit 0x1819) used in GPS and outdoor positioning sensors.

entries.name: Environmental Sensing Service
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT Environmental Sensing Service (16-bit 0x181A) for temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure sensors.

entries.name: Internet Protocol Support Service
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT IPSP service (16-bit 0x1820) enabling IPv6 over BLE (6LoWPAN).

entries.name: Device Name Characteristic
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT characteristic (16-bit 0x2A00) within Generic Access containing UTF-8 device name.

entries.name: Battery Level Characteristic
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT characteristic (16-bit 0x2A19) reporting battery charge percentage (0-100).

entries.name: Heart Rate Measurement Characteristic
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT characteristic (16-bit 0x2A37) transmitting heart rate measurement data and RR-intervals.

entries.name: Body Sensor Location Characteristic
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT characteristic (16-bit 0x2A38) indicating anatomical sensor location.

entries.name: Client Characteristic Configuration Descriptor
entries.analyst_notes: Standard GATT descriptor (16-bit 0x2902, CCCD) enabling client notifications (0x0001) and indications (0x0002).

entries.name: Serial Port Profile (SPP) Service Class
entries.analyst_notes: Standard Bluetooth Classic Serial Port Profile (SPP, 16-bit 0x1101) UUID used for RFCOMM sockets.

entries.name: Google Fast Pair Service
entries.analyst_notes: Google-assigned 16-bit UUID (0xFE2C) registered with Bluetooth SIG for Google Fast Pair Service discovery on Android.

entries.name: Exposure Notification Service
entries.source_name: Apple / Google Exposure Notification Bluetooth Specification
entries.analyst_notes: Joint Apple-Google 16-bit UUID (0xFD6F) reserved for COVID-19 contact tracing and exposure notification broadcasting.

entries.name: AOSP BluetoothChat Insecure Socket UUID
entries.analyst_notes: Canonical sample UUID embedded in official AOSP BluetoothChat sample app for insecure RFCOMM connection testing.

entries.name: AOSP BluetoothChat Secure Socket UUID
entries.analyst_notes: Canonical sample UUID embedded in official AOSP BluetoothChat sample app for secure encrypted RFCOMM connection testing.

entries.name: Nordic UART Service (NUS)
entries.analyst_notes: Proprietary but widely adopted vendor GATT service defined by Nordic Semiconductor for serial bidirectional UART emulation over BLE.

entries.name: Apple Notification Center Service (ANCS)
entries.analyst_notes: Apple proprietary GATT service allowing Bluetooth accessories to access notification alerts on iOS devices.

entries.name: Apple Media Service (AMS)
entries.analyst_notes: Apple proprietary GATT service enabling BLE accessories to control media playback on iOS devices.

entries.name: TI SensorTag IR Temperature Service
entries.analyst_notes: Texas Instruments vendor GATT service for contactless infrared temperature telemetry.
